notes.title: Patch 2016-03-29
notes.notes:
The arrows to change page not appearing solved on some systems (we'll keep digging in this).
 You can now change page with the left and right arrow on your keyboard (back on the first page takes you to the settings).
 Options added for depth of field and antialiasing.
